The primitive 'Quantitative Decline Factor' captures this degradation through a dimensionless ratio, which informs GSI’s Bayesian inference framework by downweighting college metrics. The 'Report Length Correlation' primitive introduces a linear model to assess whether descriptive verbosity correlates with draft position, providing a proxy for scout depth. These primitives form a dual system: one grounded in empirical metrics (QDF), the other in linguistic structure (QPR and RLC), both converging in a unified probabilistic draft model.
